scripts.bundle:openapi:admin: REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle docs/openapi.yaml --overlay docs/overlays/admin.yaml --output docs/dist/openapi.admin.yaml
scripts.bundle:openapi:ja: REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle docs/openapi.yaml --overlay docs/overlays/ja.yaml --output docs/dist/openapi.ja.yaml
scripts.bundle:openapi: npm run bundle:openapi:public && npm run bundle:openapi:admin && npm run bundle:openapi:ja
scripts.lint:arazzo: redocly lint docs/workflows/*.arazzo.yaml && npm run check:diagrams
scripts.lint:spectral: spectral lint docs/openapi.yaml docs/dist/openapi.yaml docs/dist/openapi.admin.yaml docs/dist/openapi.ja.yaml --ruleset .spectral.yaml --fail-severity=warn && npm run lint:arazzo
scripts.lint:openapi: npm run bundle:openapi && npm run lint:spectral
